reason: RAGAS evaluation scripts and metric adaptation require separate work. Current RAGAS results expose evaluator issues (BGE-M3 score scale, judge strictness, reference format) rather than pipeline quality failures. RAGAS is not reliable enough to serve as a quality gate for Phase 21A merge.

known_ragas_issues.answer_relevancy_bge_m3_scale: BGE-M3 produces median=0.0 for Chinese biomedical QA. 69% scores=0.0 despite topically relevant answers.
known_ragas_issues.context_precision_judge_strictness: Bimodal distribution (0.0 or 1.0). Smoke doc_hit=1.0 confirms support relevance.
known_ragas_issues.answer_correctness_reference_format: 100/100 NaN. expected_answer field is descriptive, not concise factual references.
known_ragas_issues.faithfulness_partial_signal: Usable (mean=0.71) but 10.8% NaN from length truncation. Only metric that partially works.
known_ragas_issues.metric_adaptation_pending: All metrics require domain-specific threshold calibration before use as quality gates.

how_to_handle_later: calibrate_relevancy_threshold with LLM judge instead of BGE-M3 embeddings
judge_based_relevancy as alternative to embedding-based relevancy
RAGAS200 v2 with calibrated thresholds after fixes
notes: RAGAS results are documented but excluded from Phase 21A merge gate. Smoke baseline remains the definitive quality standard. Future Phase 21B-Eval or dedicated RAGAS adaptation phase can re-address evaluation methodology.
